memories.content: The account manager is preparing for a scheduled retention call with Fenwick & Sloane. They know Fenwick & Sloane has expressed intent to cancel their subscription. The manager's goal is to persuade them to pause instead. They have prepared talking points about the benefits of pausing and potential future discounts.

Brightline Software provides a subscription service to Fenwick & Sloane. A retention call is scheduled for this week (the week of 2026-09-08). The call will discuss the subscription status. Fenwick & Sloane has indicated they want to cancel, but Brightline hopes to offer a pause as an alternative.
